title: Action Proposal
description: What a model submits to the gateway. The model never holds credentials; it proposes, and the gateway decides.

action.description: Must match the gateway allowlist exactly. Anything unrecognised is rejected, never interpreted.

target.description: Explicit. The model names a system and a record; it never sends a raw URL or query.

reason.description: Required free text. Goes in the audit log. In three months this is the field that tells you what the model thought it was doing.

confidence.description: The model's own estimate. One input to the approval decision, never the sole gate.

requires_approval.description: The model's suggestion only. The gateway overrides it. Never let the proposer decide whether it needs supervision.

proposed_by.description: Which model. Each gets its own revocable token.

idempotency_key.description: Retries and duplicate sends are guaranteed. This makes them harmless.
